body:
Subject: three at your gate (#1959, #1964, #1956 not yet); BUG-1244 round 5 queued; BUG-1250 third occurrence

Ready for you, both Done with Build green and only the by-design hold gate red:
- #1959 (TASK-1285, binary pinning + rebuild handoff) — the drain shelved it "ci-red: merge-hold-gate" at 12:46, which was the misclassification again; Build (ubuntu-latest) passes. Nothing is owed on it.
- #1964 (TASK-1287, label-only hold releasable by pr ship) — reviewer approved round 2, escalated at 11:51.

Not ready: #1956 (BUG-1244). Round 4 closed the fail-open the reviewer found but reintroduced the two queue-done integration tests that round 2 had fixed (run 35442689349). Round 5 is queued with your clarified rule spelled out: commit-evidence decides only when commits exist since merge-base; an EMPTY range accepts (fresh project, no sibling work to contaminate). That should satisfy both the reviewer's unit cases and the integration tests.

Merged since my last note: BUG-1252 (#1961), TASK-1280 (#1962) — the latter with my hand-pushed delta-reapply fix, TASK-1281 (#1963).

BUG-1264 (aliased-id member drop) is implementing now; TASK-163 stays queued behind it since it is the spec that cannot be picked up until that lands.

BUG-1250 now has three live occurrences. The hold-gate half is cheap and independent: a hold-gate-only red with the marker present must never shelve ci-red. Worth splitting into its own spec if you want it drained before the transient-probe half.
